values.meaning: Berserked units gain bonus attack speed

mechanics.claim: Enemy champions and minions hit by the cloud become berserk, causing them to prioritize attacking their allies over their enemies.
mechanics.quote: Enemy champions and minions hit become {{tip|berserk}} for a duration.

mechanics.claim: This ability can be blocked by spell shields.
In a one-on-one dummy fight there are no allies for a berserked target to attack, so the berserk effect has no practical target to redirect damage to.
mechanics.quote:
prioritize attacking the closest unit by the following categories in descending order:
# Their allied champions
